the role library because it predated the static-vs-dynamic distinction.

- Fire learn_from_dialogue as a background task so the reply returns
  immediately without waiting for insight extractio

- Max-size eviction (oldest entry dropped at 100 entries)
- dispose() clears the entire cache on engine shutdown

fix: normalize XHS CDN URLs for stable image cache keys

XHS cover URLs contain expiring timestamp/token segments:
  https://xhscdn.com/{timestamp}/{token}/{stable_path}
Each regeneration produces a different URL for the same image, causing
cache misses. Now _image_cache_key strips the timestamp/token before
hashing, so the same image always maps to the same cache entry.

When the CDN returns 403 (expired token), the cached copy is served.
